MediaPurpose.description: What the caller intends to do with an uploaded file. Required by `POST /media` (architecture 7.8) but not persisted on `media` (architecture 5.8 lists its full composition) - whether a file's kind actually fits its purpose is checked when it is bound to its entity: a person's photo, a ministry's cover, and so on.

cover_url.description:
`large` (1080px), not `thumb` (320px, architecture 7.8 defines
both sizes but not which screen uses which): unlike a
person's photo or a member row's avatar, a ministry cover is
shown banner-style at close to full card width, and
a 320px source would visibly blur stretched that wide.

photo_url.description:
Same rule as the card itself (architecture 6.4: "фото человека
 тем, у кого people.view" - see the class this resource is
never returned without passing): whoever the controller
already let see this person's card sees their photo too, so
no extra check is needed here.

purpose.description:
Required by the upload contract (architecture 7.8) but not a column on
`media` (architecture 5.8 lists its full composition) - it only states
what the caller intends to do with the file. Whether the file actually
fits that intent (e.g. an image for `person_photo`) is checked when it
is bound to its entity - a person's photo, a ministry's cover, and so on.
